args.title: Change password reset email link from localhost to public URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Update the BASE_URL to ensure that the password reset email does not link to localhost. This should use the PUBLIC_URL environment variable, allowing the link to direct users to the correct public domain instead of a localhost instance.
